</div></div><h4><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></h4>
<p>The <strong>SOX IT Manager</strong> will be responsible for managing and executing the IT SOX compliance program, focusing on <strong>ITGCs</strong> (IT General Controls), IT application controls, and system/process assessments. They will identify risks, coordinate robust control implementations, drive process automation, and collaborate with engineering, security, DevOps, and finance to comply with <strong>SOX Section 404</strong>. The role reports directly to the  SOX Senior Manager -IT.</p>
<h4><strong>About The Role:</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>Manage and execute the end-to-end IT SOX program including scoping, risk assessment, controls testing, remediation, and reporting.</li>
<li>Partner closely with IT teams to design and implement effective and scalable IT controls.</li>
<li>Manage walkthroughs, coordinate evidence collection, track remediation efforts, and ensure timely closure of audit gaps.</li>
<li>Establish and maintain SOX documentation, including risk/control matrices, and testing procedures.</li>
<li>Monitor and report on the status of IT control effectiveness and remediation progress to internal stakeholders.</li>
<li>Provide guidance and training to control owners to promote awareness and understanding of SOX compliance requirements.</li>
<li>Advise IT teams on SOX requirements related to access, change management, job management, third-party service organization and system development life cycle (SDLC) controls.</li>
<li>Deliver SOX IT training and enablement tailored for control owners</li>
<li>Perform Key reports testing</li>
<li>Provide guidance to ensure effective design and execution of SDLC controls during system implementations.</li>
</ul>
<h4><strong>Who You Are:</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li><strong>6+ years</strong> of hands-on IT audit and SOX compliance experience, preferably in both Big 4 and in-house internal audit/SOX roles.</li>
<li>Experience helping establish or scale SOX IT compliance programs at newly public or pre-IPO companies.</li>
<li>Experience with NetSuite, Salesforce, Workday and Coupa </li>
<li>Deep understanding of ITGCs, application controls, and risk assessments.</li>
<li>Hands-on, strategic, and execution-focused; thrives in fast-paced and evolving environments.</li>
<li>Strong project management, analytical, and communication skills.</li>
<li>Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Accounting, or a related field.</li>
<li>CISA or similar certification is a plus.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Wondering if you’re a good fit? </strong><strong>We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match.</strong><strong> Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk. </strong></p>
<ul>
<li>You love to build order and clarity through strong IT controls, transforming complex systems and risks into efficient, well-documented, and reliable processes.</li>
<li>You’re curious about how technology, automation, and security intersect to strengthen compliance programs and drive smarter, scalable SOX control environments.</li>
<li>You’re an expert in designing, testing, and improving IT general controls and application controls across systems like NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce, and Coupa.</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></p>
<p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast!  We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values: </p>
<ul>
<li>Be Curious at Your Core</li>
<li>Act Like an Owner</li>
<li>Empower Employees</li>
<li>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</li>
<li>Achieve More Together</li>
</ul>
<p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for take off, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!  <br><br></p>
<p><em>The base salary range for this role is $115,000 to $168,000. The starting salary will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p>
<p>The range we’ve posted represents the typical compensation range for this role. To determine actual compensation, we review the market rate for each candidate which can include a variety of factors. These include qualifications, experience, interview performance, and location.</p>
<p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p>
<ul>
<li>Medical, dental, and vision insurance - 100% paid for by CoreWeave</li>
<li>Company-paid Life Insurance </li>
<li>Voluntary supplemental life insurance </li>
<li>Short and long-term disability insurance </li>
<li>Flexible Spending Account</li>
<li>Health Savings Account</li>
<li>Tuition Reimbursement </li>
<li>Ability to Participate in Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)</li>
<li>Mental Wellness Benefits through Spring Health </li>
<li>Family-Forming support provided by Carrot</li>
<li>Paid Parental Leave </li>
<li>Flexible, full-service childcare support with Kinside</li>
<li>401(k) with a generous employer match</li>
<li>Flexible PTO</li>
<li>Catered lunch each day in our office and data center locations</li>
<li>A casual work environment</li>
<li>A work culture focused on innovative disruption</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Our Workplace</strong></p>
<p>While we prioritize a hybrid work environment, remote work may be considered for candidates located more than 30 miles from an office, based on role requirements for specialized skill sets. New hires will be invited to attend onboarding at one of our hubs within their first month. Teams also gather quarterly to support collaboration</p>
